console_status: Crash reported by user and corroborated by process monitor and retained game output.
findings: The failed run reached OpenGL initialization and resource reload. The game log ends during resource loading before a world starts. A separate earlier 26.1.1 Fabric session had completed world saves.
The retained VM trace shows SIGSEGVs with selected HotSpot continuations and subsequent execution. The available trace does not identify the terminal fault.
The per-run abort and exception markers contain no captured fatal error. The retained hs_err report belongs to an older process and cannot establish the cause of this crash.
pending: Compare build 247 and 248 on the same Fabric instance up to the title screen to isolate the Mesa cache partition change. Capture a terminal native fault or matching JVM fatal report before attributing the crash. Build 248 remains unvalidated for release.

without_sodium.evidence: Same instance and build. The retained active resource list contains Fabric API and Controlify and omits Sodium. The game again stops during resource reload before reaching the title screen, and the process monitor records a crash.
without_sodium.gc: The retained log ends during a ZGC major collection after the old-generation relocation safepoint. This establishes timing only. No matching JVM fatal report or abort identifies the cause.
